description: This file defines the DynamoDBGatewayOptions class which extends DynamoDBClientOptions and provides configuration options for DynamoDB storage in Orleans clustering. It includes properties such as ReadCapacityUnits, WriteCapacityUnits, UseProvisionedThroughput, CreateIfNotExists, UpdateIfExists, and TableName, with default values and documentation comments.
